# `aitbc system config`

Display AITBC system configuration from /etc/aitbc/blockchain.env.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system config [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--show-secrets` | flag | `false` | no | Show sensitive values like API keys |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system config
```
